capabilities: Connect a vault to SlideX via a scoped, revocable connection token
Select folders, tags, dates, and files to include in SlideX import jobs
Send import snapshots of chosen notes with their referenced images
Sync later changes only for notes explicitly linked to SlideX presentation elements
disambiguation: Not a slides or presentation plugin for Obsidian itself; it only exports selected notes to the external SlideX application.
extras: Desktop-only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README covers install, privacy, and permissions but no usage walkthrough of SlideX itself.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share only chosen notes with an external presentation tool without exposing the whole vault or letting the tool write to it.
summary: Read-only desktop bridge that sends selected Obsidian notes and referenced images to the SlideX app for presentation deck imports.
